versions.changelog:
- 许可证文件（LICENSE）和主技能文件新增，完善了开源合规和技能定义。
- 移除四个与发布和自动化相关的脚本和文档，精简了项目结构。
- 功能与核心文档内容保持不变，用户体验一致。

Initial release of the interactive DMAIC process improvement assistant.

- Guides users step-by-step through all five DMAIC stages: 定义 (Define), 测量 (Measure), 分析 (Analyze), 改进 (Improve), 控制 (Control)
- Each stage supports multi-tool selection with structured, single-question dialogs for tool execution
- Features multi-expert review at every step (质量专家、流程专家、客户代表); users address feedback before proceeding
- Provides detailed, stage-wise documentation and auto-generates a comprehensive final project report
- Collects optional background to tailor recommendations; supports file uploads for context
- Robust exception handling: users can return to previous steps, skip expert review, or end/save the project at any time
